DefaultBillTo.dc.html.canvasTitle: Set a customer's default Bill To
DefaultBillTo.dc.html.title: 1. Set a customer's default Bill To

figures.heading: New Customer
figures.alt: New Customer window in production
captions: No Bill To field. The red "Oooops! An error occurred" toast and the empty list behind are the production code reading this build's data copy; they are not part of the window.

figures.heading: Bill Invoices To, empty
figures.alt: New Customer with the Bill Invoices To field reading This customer
captions: "Bill Invoices To" sits after Credit Terms and Credit Limit and before Sales Representative. It reads "This customer".
No help line under it in New Customer.

figures.heading: Open
figures.alt: Bill Invoices To list open
captions: Name typed: "Lone Star Fleet Services". The first option reads "Lone Star Fleet Services (this customer)", then customers A to Z: "4 Star Truck Repair", "7 Star Truck Repair", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", "Aberdeen Diesel Services LLC".
The list holds the first 50 customers A to Z; typing narrows it. Reshot after the tech review.

figures.heading: Searching
figures.alt: Bill Invoices To searching A and J
captions: Typing "A & J" narrows the list. The "(this customer)" option stays first.

figures.heading: Picked
figures.alt: A and J picked in Bill Invoices To
captions: "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair" picked. It saves with Save, right after the customer is created. Not saved here.

figures.heading: Edit Customer
figures.alt: Edit Customer in production
captions: No Bill To field. Shot 1440 x 1300 so the whole window shows.

figures.heading: Saved default
figures.alt: Edit Customer with Bill Invoices To A and J
captions: "Bill Invoices To" shows the saved default, "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair".
Help line, Edit Customer only: "New work orders and part sales bill to this customer. Existing ones don't change."
Address 2 has a value, so it shows, with an x to clear it.

figures.heading: Open
figures.alt: Edit Customer Bill Invoices To list open
captions: The list opens with "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then customers A to Z. The current pick, "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", is highlighted in its A to Z place. Picking "(this customer)" and saving clears the default.
Reshot after the tech review. Buda's saved default had been cleared in the build's data before this reshoot; it was set back to A & J for these shots and cleared again after.

figures.heading: Searching
figures.alt: Edit Customer Bill Invoices To searching Vald
captions: Typing "Vald": "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)", then "Uvalde Estates Truck Centre" and "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair", A to Z. Closed without saving.

figures.heading: Edit Customer, Counter Sale customer
figures.alt: Edit Customer on the Counter Sale customer with no Bill Invoices To field
captions: In this data the Counter Sale customer is named "Gennadiy's Mobile Truck Repair". Its Edit Customer window has no "Bill Invoices To" field and no help line: Credit Terms and Credit Limit are followed directly by Sales Representative.
No before board: production has no "Bill Invoices To" field on any customer, so production's window for this customer matches the production Edit Customer board above. Shot 1440 x 1300.

figures.heading: Customer page
figures.alt: Buda customer page in production
captions: The card ends with IBS, then Contacts and Assets.

figures.heading: Bill Invoices To line
figures.alt: Buda customer page with Bill Invoices To line
captions: Under IBS: "Bill Invoices To", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", and "Change".
The line shows only when another customer is saved. A customer that bills itself shows nothing here.

figures.heading: Change
figures.alt: Bill Invoices To window
captions: Window "Bill Invoices To": "New work orders and part sales for Buda Truck Repair will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."
Buttons "Cancel" and "Save".

figures.heading: Change, open
figures.alt: Bill Invoices To window with the list open
captions: The list opens above the field when there is no room below: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then customers A to Z, the current pick "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair" highlighted. Closed without saving. Reshot after the tech review.

figures.heading: Customer page
figures.alt: A and J customer page in production
captions: Contacts and Assets only.

figures.heading: Pays for counter
figures.alt: A and J customer page with Pays for 1
captions: "Pays for" 1 sits beside Contacts and Assets. Hidden when the count is 0.
A & J has its own default, so it also shows "Bill Invoices To", "Mayfield Heights Truck Centre", "Change". New work orders for Buda still bill A & J, one hop only.

figures.heading: Tooltip
figures.alt: Pays for tooltip
captions: Tooltip: "Customers billed to this customer by default".

figures.heading: Pays for list
figures.alt: A and J pays for window
captions: Window "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair pays for": "These customers bill new work orders and part sales to A & J Truck & Trailer Repair by default."
Each customer is a link to its page ("Buda Truck Repair"). Button "Close".
Customers are listed A to Z, and a long list scrolls inside the window. A & J pays for one customer, so this window looks the same after the tech review; not reshot.

figures.heading: New Customer
figures.alt: New Customer for a Foreman in production
captions: Her location is Staging Lethbridge - 4310; customers are shared across the organization.

figures.heading: New Customer
figures.alt: New Customer for a Foreman in this build
captions: No "Bill Invoices To" field; the window closes up around it.

figures.heading: Customer page
figures.alt: Buda page for a Foreman in production
captions: The customer card as her role sees it today.

figures.heading: Customer page
figures.alt: Buda page for a Foreman in this build
captions: She still sees "Bill Invoices To", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", with no "Change".

figures.heading: Edit Customer
figures.alt: Edit Customer for a Foreman in production

figures.heading: Edit Customer
figures.alt: Edit Customer for a Foreman in this build
captions: No "Bill Invoices To" field and no help line. The saved default is untouched when she saves.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: Buda page on a phone in production
captions: 390 wide.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: Buda page on a phone in this build
captions: The same "Bill Invoices To" line with "Change", under IBS. Nothing phone-only.

captions: First option: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)", then customers A to Z: "4 Star Truck Repair", "7 Star Truck Repair", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", "Aberdeen Diesel Services LLC" and on. Never Counter Sale.
The list holds the first 50 customers A to Z; typing narrows it.
Reshot after the tech review (the list used to come in database order).

figures.heading: Searching
figures.alt: Bill To searching Vald
captions: Typing "Vald": "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)", then A to Z "Uvalde Estates Truck Centre", "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair".
Reshot after the tech review.

figures.heading: No match
figures.alt: Bill To with no matching customer
captions: Typing "zzqx": only "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" stays. The "(this customer)" option is always listed, so the list is never empty.
Rechecked after the tech review: unchanged.

figures.heading: Picked
figures.alt: Bill To Valders picked
captions: Picking "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" saves at once. The card shows "Bill To" "Valders Diesel & Fleet Re", cut at the card's width.
Reverted after the shot.

figures.heading: S2-17579
figures.alt: S2-17579 in production
captions: Nothing says who pays.

figures.heading: S2-17579
figures.alt: S2-17579 with Bill To Valders
captions: "Bill To" reads "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair". Nothing is added to the card's header or the work order header.

figures.heading: Authorizer list (S2-17577)
figures.alt: Authorizer list in production
captions: S2-17577 is Desert Edge billed to 7 Star. Production lists Desert Edge's contacts only, one line each.
The "Over Limit" pill in the header is production's credit check; this build's Credit Terms work skips it for COD.

figures.heading: Authorizer list, top
figures.alt: Authorizer list with customer names
captions: "No authorizer", then the customer's contacts, each with "Desert Edge Truck Service & Repair" on a second line.

figures.heading: Authorizer list, bottom
figures.alt: Authorizer list scrolled to the Bill To contact
captions: The Bill To's contacts come last: "Jaime Johnson", "7 Star Truck Repair".
When the customer pays for itself the list is exactly today's, with no second line.

figures.heading: Card
figures.alt: S2-17577 in production with the Change Customer button
captions: The Change Customer button (two arrows at the top right of the customer card) is enabled. The "Over Limit" pill is production's credit check; not Bill To.
The same production board as page 3's deposit row.

figures.heading: Change Customer enabled
figures.alt: S2-17577 with the Change Customer button enabled
captions: The Change Customer button stays enabled while the deposit is held, as in production. The deposit no longer greys it out.
The server refuses Change Customer only when the change would change the Bill To; picking a customer that keeps "7 Star Truck Repair" as Bill To goes through.
New after the tech review. The refusal was not shot: it needs a real Change Customer attempt.

figures.heading: Work Order Log
figures.alt: Work Order Log in production
captions: The "Bill To changed" rows exist only because this build wrote them into the shared data. Production reads them as "Customer:" changes. Production itself never writes them.

figures.heading: Work Order Log
figures.alt: Work Order Log with Bill To changed rows
captions: Event "Bill To changed". Details: "Bill To:" old customer, arrow, new customer, each a link (for example "Buda Truck Repair" to "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair").
These rows come from earlier testing on this work order.

figures.heading: Part sale P2-256
figures.alt: Part sale P2-256 in production
captions: 4 Star Truck Repair card: Contact, Phone, Authorizer.

figures.heading: Part sale P2-256
figures.alt: Part sale P2-256 with Bill To 7 Star
captions: The same "Bill To" field, here "7 Star Truck Repair".
The parts table columns differ from production (Quantity, Requested At, Fees & Discounts). That comes from newer develop work under this build, not Bill To.

figures.heading: New Work Order
figures.alt: New Work Order in production
captions: Buda Truck Repair and its CV515 picked.

figures.heading: New Work Order, unchanged
figures.alt: New Work Order in this build
captions: The window is pixel-identical to production. No Bill To here; Buda's saved default applies quietly when the work order is created.
Accuracy check: the Work Orders list toolbar behind the window is spaced differently (tabs and Search sit further left). That comes from release fixes newer than this build's base, not Bill To.

figures.heading: S2-17579
figures.alt: S2-17579 details on a phone in production
captions: Details shown.

figures.heading: S2-17579
figures.alt: S2-17579 details on a phone with Bill To
captions: The same card, with "Bill To" "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" under Authorizer. Nothing phone-only.

Blocked.dc.html.canvasTitle: When the Bill To is blocked
Blocked.dc.html.title: 3. When the Bill To is blocked

figures.heading: Invoiced card
figures.alt: S2-17581 in production
captions: No Bill To on the card.

figures.heading: Read-only
figures.alt: S2-17581 with read-only Bill To
captions: "Bill To" "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair", read-only.

figures.heading: Hover
figures.alt: Invoiced tooltip
captions: Tooltip: "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."
No tooltip and no toast in history mode.

figures.heading: Click
figures.alt: Invoiced toast with Go To Invoice
captions: Error toast with the same words and "Go To Invoice" and "Close". "Go To Invoice" opens the Finance tab; it never reverses anything.
Anyone who can see the field gets the toast. "Go To Invoice" shows only for users who can open the Finance tab; others get the message and "Close" only.
Rechecked after the tech review: pixel-identical to the earlier shot, so not replaced.

figures.heading: Card
figures.alt: S2-17577 in production
captions: No Bill To on the card. The "Over Limit" pill is production's credit check; not Bill To.

figures.heading: Read-only
figures.alt: S2-17577 with read-only Bill To
captions: "Bill To" "7 Star Truck Repair", read-only while the deposit is held.
The Change Customer button (two arrows at the top right of the customer card) stays enabled. The server refuses Change Customer only when it would change the Bill To.
Reshot after the tech review.

figures.heading: Hover
figures.alt: Deposit tooltip
captions: Tooltip: "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from 7 Star Truck Repair. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."

figures.heading: Click
figures.alt: Deposit toast with Open Deposits
captions: Error toast with the same words, "Open Deposits" and "Close". "Open Deposits" opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the largest share.
Shot as admin, who can open Deposits. The hover tooltip also shows at the bottom left because the pointer is still on the field. Reshot after the tech review.

figures.heading: Card (admin)
figures.alt: S2-17577 in production
captions: The same production board as the row above: production has no Bill To, so there is nothing to tap. No production board was shot as mary.moore for this work order.

figures.heading: Card
figures.alt: S2-17577 as mary.moore with the Bill To shown read-only
captions: She sees "Bill To" "7 Star Truck Repair" because someone else pays.

Accuracy check: the top bar shows her role's menu (no Dashboard, no Reports, a wider search box) and "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919". Her only location is Staging Lethbridge - 4310, so for these shots her staff location was moved to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and moved back after. Not Bill To.

figures.heading: Click
figures.alt: Deposit toast with only Close for mary.moore
captions: Error toast: "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from 7 Star Truck Repair. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To." with "Close" only.
No "Open Deposits": she cannot open a customer's Deposits tab. The tooltip with the same words shows at the bottom left because the pointer is still on the field.

figures.heading: Phone, tap
figures.alt: Deposit toast on a phone for mary.moore
captions: Details open, the Bill To field tapped (it sits below the fold, under the toast). The same toast, "Close" only. A tap never depends on a hover.

figures.heading: Lines
figures.alt: S2-17579 in production with the payer on Credit Hold
captions: Production checks only Buda, which is on COD, so no banner.

figures.heading: Banner
figures.alt: Credit Hold banner naming the Bill To
captions: Banner: "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair, is on Credit Hold", with "Change Bill To".
The work order header shows a "Credit Hold" pill.

figures.heading: Finance
figures.alt: Finance tab in production
captions: No banner. Create Invoice is greyed here only because no line is complete yet.

figures.heading: Finance
figures.alt: Finance tab with the banner and Create Invoice disabled
captions: The same banner on Finance. Create Invoice is greyed here because no line is complete; the Credit Hold tooltip on it was not shot.
The toolbar (Customer PO, icons, Add Deposit, Create Invoice) sits where it does in production.

figures.heading: Change Bill To
figures.alt: Change Bill To opens the card's Bill To list
captions: "Change Bill To" opens and focuses the card's Bill To field, so the page scrolls to it.

The list: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then the current Bill To "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" highlighted, then customers A to Z ("4 Star Truck Repair", "7 Star Truck Repair", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair"). Reshot after the tech review.

figures.heading: Counter Sale not offered
figures.alt: Searching the Counter Sale customer finds nothing
captions: In this data the Counter Sale customer is named "Gennadiy's Mobile Truck Repair". Typing "Gennadiy" in Bill To leaves only "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)".

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: S2-17579 on a phone in production
captions: No banner.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: S2-17579 on a phone with Credit Hold
captions: The "Credit Hold" pill shows in the phone header, and the banner "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair, is on Credit Hold" with "Change Bill To" sits above the lines.

figures.heading: Phone, Change Bill To
figures.alt: Change Bill To on a phone opens Details and the Bill To list
captions: Tapping "Change Bill To" opens the phone Details, scrolls to the Bill To field and opens its list: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)", "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" highlighted, then customers A to Z.
New after the tech review (it used to target the card hidden behind Details, so nothing visible happened). Closed without saving.

ServiceFor.dc.html.canvasTitle: Service For band on invoices and estimates
ServiceFor.dc.html.title: 4. Service For band on invoices and estimates

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern invoice in production
captions: The Bill To block names Valders only because this build created the invoice and saved Valders on it. Production, creating it, would have saved Buda. Nothing says whose truck it was.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern invoice with the Service For band
captions: A full-width band under the address row: "SERVICE FOR", "Buda Truck Repair", "Unit 854", "2024 INTERNATIONAL CV515", joined by " · ".
Light grey fill and thin grey border, so it reads in black and white.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy invoice in production
captions: Same note on the Bill To block as the modern one.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy invoice with the Service For band
captions: The same band, under Bill To and Remit payment to, above the asset table.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern estimate in production
captions: Rendered live from the work order: the Bill To block is the customer, A & J Truck & Trailer Repair. This is production's true behavior.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern estimate billed to Buda with Service For
captions: Bill To: "Buda Truck Repair" with its address. Band: "SERVICE FOR", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", "2017 Ford Transit". The asset has no unit, so "Unit" drops out with its separator.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy estimate in production
captions: Bill To is A & J.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy estimate with Service For
captions: Bill To is Buda; the same band.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern part sale estimate in production
captions: Bill To is the customer, 4 Star.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern part sale with Service For and unit
captions: Bill To is 7 Star. Band: "SERVICE FOR", "4 Star Truck Repair", "Unit 4417", "2011 Hyundai Santa Fe".

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy part sale estimate in production
captions: Bill To is 4 Star.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy part sale with Service For and unit
captions: The same band with the unit.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern part sale without vehicle in production
captions: Bill To is 4 Star.

figures.heading: Modern
figures.alt: Modern part sale without vehicle with Service For
captions: Band: "SERVICE FOR", "4 Star Truck Repair" only.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy part sale without vehicle in production
captions: Bill To is 4 Star.

figures.heading: Legacy
figures.alt: Legacy part sale without vehicle with Service For
captions: Name only.

figures.heading: Modern, pays for itself
figures.alt: Modern invoice that pays for itself in production
captions: S2-17322 bills its own customer.

figures.heading: Modern, pays for itself
figures.alt: Modern invoice that pays for itself in this build
captions: No band. Pixel-identical to production (compared).

figures.heading: Legacy, pays for itself
figures.alt: Legacy invoice that pays for itself in production

figures.heading: Legacy, pays for itself
figures.alt: Legacy invoice that pays for itself in this build
captions: No band. Pixel-identical to production (compared).

figures.heading: Batch, page 1
figures.alt: Batch invoice page 1 in production
captions: Batch of S2-17581, S2-17513 and S2-17322. Page 1 shown.

figures.heading: Batch, page 1
figures.alt: Batch invoice page 1 with Service For
captions: Page 1 is S2-17581 with its band. In the full PDF each invoice billed to someone else gets its own band; S2-17513 reads "SERVICE FOR", "Orchard City Truck & Trailer Repair", "Unit 15", "2018 Freightliner 114sd". S2-17322 gets none.

GettingPaid.dc.html.title: 5. Getting paid

figures.heading: A & J, Invoices
figures.alt: A and J invoices in production
captions: Date, Type, No., Memo, Total, Balance, Status, Action. Nothing says whose work each invoice was.

figures.heading: A & J, Invoices
figures.alt: A and J invoices with the Service For column
captions: New column after No.: header "Service For", naming the customer the work was for.
The column is hidden when no row on the tab is billed for someone else.

figures.heading: Valders, Open only off
figures.alt: Valders invoices in production
captions: S2-17581 listed with no Service For column.

figures.heading: Valders, Open only off
figures.alt: Valders invoices with Service For Buda
captions: S2-17581, Service For "Buda Truck Repair", Paid.

figures.heading: Rows picked
figures.alt: A and J rows selected in production
captions: Both invoices ticked; New Payment turns on.

figures.heading: Rows picked
figures.alt: A and J rows selected in this build
captions: The same, with the Service For column.

figures.heading: New Customer Payment
figures.alt: New Customer Payment in production
captions: The payment window.

figures.heading: New Customer Payment
figures.alt: New Customer Payment in this build
captions: The window is unchanged: S2-17362 and S2-17513, Payment amount $1,679.02. One payment covers several of the payer's invoices across the customers it pays for.
A payment applied to another customer's invoice is refused by the server; that refusal has no screen here.

figures.heading: Orchard City, Invoices
figures.alt: Orchard City invoices in production
captions: Empty on this data.

figures.heading: Orchard City, Invoices
figures.alt: Orchard City invoices in this build
captions: S2-17513 was Orchard City's work but is not on its tab, so it cannot be paid from Orchard City's side.

figures.heading: Sending invoice (S2-17581)
figures.alt: Sending invoice in production
captions: Lists Buda's contact, "Wendy Lopez", ticked.

figures.heading: Sending invoice (S2-17581)
figures.alt: Sending invoice to the Bill To contact
captions: Lists the Bill To's contacts and ticks "George Thomas" (Valders): its Billing contact, else its first.
"Include 'For Customer' Attachments in email" starts unticked, as today.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: A and J invoices on a phone in production
captions: The customer card comes first on a phone; the tab is below.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: A and J invoices on a phone in this build
captions: Same order as production. Nothing phone-only.

DeletePayer.dc.html.canvasTitle: Deleting a customer that pays for others
DeletePayer.dc.html.title: 6. Deleting a customer that pays for others

figures.heading: Edit Customer, Delete
figures.alt: Edit Customer for Murrieta in production
captions: Delete is available.

figures.heading: Edit Customer, Delete
figures.alt: Edit Customer for Murrieta in this build
captions: Murrieta's card shows "Pays for" 1. Delete is still available; the check happens on delete.

figures.heading: Confirmation
figures.alt: Delete confirmation in production
captions: "Confirmation": "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with "Cancel" and "Delete". Confirming would delete it; not clicked.

figures.heading: Confirmation
figures.alt: Delete confirmation in this build
captions: The same confirmation, unchanged.

figures.heading: Delete Customer refused
figures.alt: Delete Customer window naming the dependent customer
captions: Window "Delete Customer": "This customer is the default Bill To for Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair. Remove it from that customer first." Each dependent customer is a link.
Buttons "Cancel" and "Remove As Default Bill To" (app buttons render in Title Case).

figures.heading: Remove as default Bill To
figures.alt: Remove as default Bill To confirmation
captions: "Remove as default Bill To": "Remove Murrieta Diesel Repair as the default Bill To for 1 customer? Open work orders keep their Bill To." Buttons "Cancel" and "Remove".

figures.heading: After Remove
figures.alt: Back on the delete confirmation after Remove
captions: The default is cleared and the user is back on the delete "Confirmation"; the user deletes again from there (not clicked here).
Fixed after these shots: the customer page now refreshes when the default is removed, so "Pays for" 1 disappears at once.

figures.heading: Result
figures.alt: Murrieta page after the default was removed
captions: Reloaded: no "Pays for" counter. Valders now bills itself for new work.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: Delete confirmation on a phone in production
captions: Confirmation on a phone.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: Delete confirmation on a phone in this build
captions: The default had already been removed, so this shows the plain confirmation, same as production.

AssetTab.dc.html.title: 7. Asset Work Orders tab

figures.heading: Work Orders tab
figures.alt: Asset Work Orders tab in production
captions: Only the current owner's work: S2-16988. Toolbar: Search, Status, New.

figures.heading: Whole history
figures.alt: Asset Work Orders tab with the whole history
captions: Every work order on the asset at this location, for every owner and payer, oldest first as today: Kolosov's work orders now appear too.
No row here bills someone else, so there is no "Bill To" column (see the S2-17579 asset below). Rechecked after the tech review: pixel-identical, not replaced.
New chip between Status and New: "Customer: All customers". Search and Status shift left to make room; New stays at the right edge. The chip is the only addition and nothing wraps.
Release-day change: old owners' jobs appear on this tab.

figures.heading: Customer chip open
figures.alt: Customer chip open
captions: "All customers" ticked, then "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then each customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z: "Kolosov's Diesel Repair", "Quartzsite Truck Service & Repair".
Search shows only with more than 8 options.

figures.heading: One customer picked
figures.alt: Quartzsite picked in the Customer chip
captions: Quartzsite ticked: "1 selected", and the chip reads "Customer: Quartzsite Truc...".

figures.heading: Applied
figures.alt: Customer filter applied
captions: Only S2-16988. A work order matches when a picked customer is its customer or its Bill To.

figures.heading: 1600 wide, search "S2-16"
figures.alt: Asset tab at 1600 with search in production
captions: One match from the current owner, S2-16988.

figures.heading: 1600 wide, search "S2-16"
figures.alt: Asset tab at 1600 with search in this build
captions: Searching the whole history finds Kolosov's S2-16894 as well. The search box, Status, Customer chip and New sit on one line at 1600; nothing wraps.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: Asset page on a phone in production
captions: The asset card comes first on a phone.

figures.heading: Phone
figures.alt: Asset page on a phone in this build
captions: Same order as production.

figures.heading: Work Orders tab, top
figures.alt: Asset Work Orders tab with a Bill To column
captions: A "Bill To" column sits right after Customer because a loaded row bills someone else. S2-17579 reads "Buda Truck Repair", "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair".
Self-billed rows leave the Bill To cell blank. Oldest first, as today.
At 1440 the extra column pushes the last columns past the right edge; the table scrolls sideways.
No production board for this asset: production was not re-run for this update. Production's tab has no Bill To column on any asset (see the "shop heavy" before board above).
Accuracy check: top bar identical to production; the tab toolbar differs from production only by the Customer chip (this build) and the Invoices count, which is this asset's data.

figures.heading: Work Orders tab, scrolled
figures.alt: Asset Work Orders tab scrolled to the last rows
captions: The last two rows, S2-17579 (Approved) and S2-17581 (Paid), both read "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" under Bill To.
When no loaded row bills someone else the column is not shown at all.
